original_question: Determine the Hilbert function sequences H for non-graded Artinian algebras such that the family Z(H) of all algebras with Hilbert function H has several irreducible components whose general points share the same generic Jordan type but differ in one of the refined Jordan-type invariants such as sequential Jordan type, Loewy sequential Jordan type, or double sequential Jordan type.
target_in_paper: Question 5.4 in Section 5 ("Lefschetz properties and Jordan types of Artinian algebras").
correct_elements: Your draft is very close to the paper’s actual target. It correctly identifies the ambient class (non-graded Artinian algebras), the fixed Hilbert function H, the parameter family Z(H), the phenomenon of multiple irreducible components, and the precise contrast the paper asks for: the general algebras on those components should have the same generic Jordan type but differ in a refined non-graded Jordan invariant such as sequential Jordan type, Loewy sequential Jordan type, or double sequential Jordan type.
missing_details: The paper’s Section 5 works over an arbitrary field K; this should be stated explicitly in a stand-alone formulation.

Section 5 defines Jordan type via multiplication by an element l in the maximal ideal m_A of an Artinian algebra A. A stand-alone question should spell out that the comparison is between the Jordan types of multiplication by a general element of m_A.
Because the algebras are non-graded, a stand-alone version should specify what is meant by the Hilbert function H in this setting; the paper leaves this standard local-Artinian convention implicit.
The official formulation explicitly names the family Z(H) and its irreducible components Xi_1, Xi_2, ... .

The nearby context makes clear that the refined invariants in view are sequential Jordan type, Loewy sequential Jordan type, and double sequential Jordan type, and that these invariants are semicontinuous in families with fixed Hilbert function.

The motivating sentence just before Question 5.4 refers to earlier component-separation results for families Gor(H) of Artinian Gorenstein algebras, but Question 5.4 itself is not restricted to Gorenstein algebras, nor to a fixed codimension; a faithful rewrite should avoid adding such restrictions.
refined_question: Over an arbitrary field K, let Z(H) denote the family of non-graded Artinian K-algebras A with Hilbert function H. For which Hilbert function sequences H does Z(H) have several irreducible components Xi_1, Xi_2, ... such that, for a general algebra A on each Xi_i, the Jordan type of multiplication by a general element l of the maximal ideal m_A is the same on all these components, while the components are nevertheless distinguished by one of the refined non-graded Jordan invariants—namely sequential Jordan type, Loewy sequential Jordan type, or double sequential Jordan type?
justification: The draft is essentially aiming at Question 5.4 and is already very close to the paper’s wording. I kept the scope exactly there: non-graded Artinian algebras with fixed Hilbert function, several irreducible components of Z(H), same generic Jordan type, and separation only by refined non-graded Jordan invariants. I did not broaden the problem to graded algebras, nor restrict it to Gorenstein algebras or codimension-three examples, because Section 5 presents those only as surrounding context and motivation, not as the statement of the open problem itself. The only additions are the implicit setup from Section 5 needed to make the question stand-alone: the ambient field K, the maximal ideal m_A, and the operator whose Jordan type is being compared.
